id: title:joethreepwood:add notifications tab to saved insights

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a dedicated rage-click notification destination, complete HogQL query and parsing, and customer-facing UI configuration for Product Analytics alerts, while retaining Slack-specific formatting and deduplication.
review.reason: The chunk establishes a bounded, substantive capability: P1.F2 adds the rage-click destination and deduplication configuration; P1.F9 implements the HogQL query and parsing utility to fetch and normalize recent rage-click events; P1.F7 and P1.F8 add the customer-facing UI and report definitions. P1.F1 and P1.F12 provide supporting Slack and state management. This demonstrates a new
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the backend implementation, shared notification configuration, or complete Product Analytics notification component, so end-to-end delivery and backend compatibility cannot be established. P1.F13 and P1.F14 are incomplete, lacking broader implementation and tests. P1.F12 and P1.F13 are single hunks without established relationships to other changes. P1.F1
